steps.name: offline-source-cache-storage
steps.summary: IndexedDB v2 source-cache stores validated ChapterSource records by canonical URL with safe miss and unavailable results.

steps.name: offline-reader-recovery
steps.summary: Reader sessions cache validated online chapters and restore complete source and translation caches offline without source or Gemini requests.

steps.name: selective-failed-chunk-retry
steps.summary: Failed-chunk retries send only validated failed chunks, retain prior successes by paragraph ID, and cache only complete merged translations.

steps.name: partial-failure-feedback
steps.summary: Partial failures now expose de-duplicated safe public error messages and only retry eligible failed chunks while preserving completed paragraphs.

steps.name: api-key-deletion
steps.summary: Settings now delete only a saved Gemini API Key through an explicit confirmation without validation or clearing other local data.
